title: DeadlineTrigger
description: PACK-09, Framework 0.8.1 hard invariants 39 and 59. Owned by compliance-service (epd2_compliance_service.notices.DeadlineTrigger). The recorded fact that ONE governed source started ONE deadline, exactly once. `source` deliberately CANNOT be delivery_telemetry or read_telemetry: those members exist in the TriggerSource enum so the refusal is explicit and testable by name rather than an omission. When `source` is notice_effect_decision, `notice_effect_id` is non-null. No field in this payload carries an identity attribute, a global person identifier, a party or authority handle, a document or its bytes, message content, an authentication secret, or any ballot/vote/tally/delegation reference (PACK-09 required invariants 1, 11, 12 and 13; Framework 0.8.1 section 11).
